description_en: Queries log data in a specified Logstore of a project. [Deprecated] Use the GetLogsV2 operation instead
description_zh: 查询指定Project下某个Logstore中的日志数据。已废弃，请使用 GetLogsV2 接口替代
kebab_example: aliyun sls get-logs --project ali-test-project --logstore example-logstore --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLogs

parameters.help_en: The Logstore from which to query data
parameters.name: logstore

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to page forward or backward in a scan or phrase query
parameters.help_zh: scan或短语查询表示是否向前或向后翻页
parameters.name: forward

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. This time refers to the log time specified when log data is written.

The time range defined by the from and to request parameters follows the left-closed and right-open principle. The time range includes the start time but excludes the end time. If the values of from and to are the same, the time range is invalid, and the function returns an error.
The value is a UNIX timestamp, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间点。该时间是指写入日志数据时指定的日志时间。

请求参数from和to定义的时间区间遵循左闭右开原则，即该时间区间包括区间开始时间点，但不包括区间结束时间点。如果from和to的值相同，则为无效区间，函数直接返回错误。
Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable nanosecond-level ordering
parameters.name: is_accurate

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of logs to return. This parameter is valid only when the query parameter is set to a query statement. Minimum value: 0. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 仅当query参数为查询语句时，该参数有效，表示请求返回的最大日志条数。最小值为0，最大值为100，默认值为100
parameters.name: line

parameters.help_en: The starting line of the query. This parameter is valid only when the query parameter is set to a query statement. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 仅当query参数为查询语句时，该参数有效，表示查询开始行。默认值为0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable enhanced SQL. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启增强sql，默认关闭
parameters.name: power_sql

parameters.example: status: 401 | SELECT remote_addr,COUNT(*) as pv GROUP by remote_addr ORDER by pv desc limit 5
parameters.help_en:
The query statement or analytic statement. For more information, see Query overview and Analysis overview.

To use Dedicated SQL, add set session parallel_sql=true; to the analytic statement in the query parameter. Example: * | set session parallel_sql=true; select count(*) as pv.

Note: When the query parameter contains an analytic statement (SQL statement), the line and offset parameters of this operation are invalid. Set them to 0 and use the LIMIT clause in the SQL statement for pagination. For more information, see Paginate query and analysis results
parameters.help_zh:
查询语句或者分析语句。更多信息，请参见查询概述和分析概述。

在query参数的分析语句中加上set session parallel_sql=true;，表示使用SQL独享版。例如* | set session parallel_sql=true; select count(*) as pv 。

说明 当query参数中有分析语句（SQL语句）时，该接口的line参数和offset参数无效，建议设置为0，需通过SQL语句的LIMIT语法实现翻页。更多信息，请参见分页显示查询分析结果
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return logs in descending order of log timestamps, accurate to the minute.

Valid values:
true: Returns logs in descending order of log timestamps.
false: Returns logs in ascending order of log timestamps. This is the default value.

Note
When the query parameter is set to a query statement, the reverse parameter is valid and specifies the sort order of the returned logs.
When the query parameter is set to a query and analytic statement, the reverse parameter is invalid. The sort order is specified by the ORDER BY clause in the SQL analytic statement. If the ORDER BY clause is set to ASC (default), the sort order is ascending. If the ORDER BY clause is set to DESC, the sort order is descending
parameters.help_zh:
用于指定返回结果是否按日志时间戳降序返回日志，精确到分钟级别。

true：按照日志时间戳降序返回日志。
false（默认值）：按照日志时间戳升序返回日志。
注意
当query参数为查询语句时，参数reverse有效，用于指定返回日志排序方式。
当query参数为查询和分析语句时，参数reverse无效，由SQL分析语句中order by语法指定排序方式。如果order by为asc（默认），则为升序；如果order by为desc，则为降序
parameters.name: reverse

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. This time refers to the log time specified when log data is written.

The time range defined by the from and to request parameters follows the left-closed and right-open principle. The time range includes the start time but excludes the end time. If the values of from and to are the same, the time range is invalid, and the function returns an error.
The value is a UNIX timestamp, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on January 1, 1970
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间点。该时间是指写入日志数据时指定的日志时间。

请求参数from和to定义的时间区间遵循左闭右开原则，即该时间区间包括区间开始时间点，但不包括区间结束时间点。如果from和to的值相同，则为无效区间，函数直接返回错误。
Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: to
